title: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, 4.7 Applied Optimization Problems: Set up and solve optimization problems in several applied fields.
summary: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, 4.7 Applied Optimization Problems: Set up and solve optimization problems in several applied fields.
body: OpenStax Calculus Volume 1, section "4.7 Applied Optimization Problems", prints these objectives: "Set up and solve optimization problems in several applied fields.". The section text says: "One common application of calculus is calculating the minimum or maximum value of a function. For example, companies often want to minimize production costs or maximize revenue. In manufacturing, it is often desirable to minimize the amount of material used to package a product with a certain volume. In this section, we show how to set up these types of minimization and maximization problems and solve them by using the tools developed in this chapter." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
